source.name: Viking FK – 'Lyse forlenger med historisk avtale'
source.note: Club announcement renewing Lyse as hovedsamarbeidspartner (main partner, since 1994 per the club's partner page). The 2026 home-kit launch article does not name sponsors; the chest placement is carried by this club article and is visible on the club's 2026 kit photo.
source.quote: det er stor stolthet knyttet til at Viking-spillerne har Lyse på brystet

source.name: Viking FK – OBOS partner page
source.note: Club partner page (partner since 2018). The 2026 home-kit launch article does not name sponsors; the centre-chest placement is read from the club's 2026 kit photo.
source.quote: OBOS bygger framtidens samfunn og oppfyller boligdrømmer.

source.name: Viking FK – SpareBank 1 Sør-Norge partner page
source.note: Club partner page (partner since 1899, premium partner). The 2026 home-kit launch article does not name sponsors; the both-shoulders placement is read from the club's 2026 kit photo.
source.quote: Som Norges nest største norskeide bank gir konsernet økonomisk kraft til vekst, verdiskaping og lønnsomhet

source.name: Viking FK – 'Kabal blir med Viking ut i Europa'
source.note: Club announcement naming Kabal as draktsponsor on the 2026 European kit. The text does not name Kabal for the home shirt; the white circular right-sleeve logo on the club's 2026 home-kit photo matches Kabal's logo, but no text source confirms Kabal on the home shirt (flagged in the PR).
source.quote: Store kamper fortjener flotte drakter, og på Vikings nye, rå europadrakter har Kabal-logoen en tydelig og stolt plass.

source.name: Viking FK – 'Viking har Eliteseriens fineste drakt 2026'
source.note: Kit maker. Club article naming Diadora as the maker of the 2026 kit.
source.quote: Den retroinspirerte drakta fra Diadora baserer seg på klubbens tradisjonelle uttrykk, men med moderne detaljer

summary: Lyse, owned by 15 Norwegian municipalities, has the front of a Diadora-made shirt; OBOS sits centre chest and SpareBank 1 Sør-Norge on the shoulders. All five sponsors rated none.
headline: The shirt is {level}: the front sponsor, Lyse, is owned by 15 Norwegian municipalities.
